en-UK.name: Beilu AIRP
en-UK.description: Symbol-based scene rendering: DSL tags to styled HTML.
en-UK.description_markdown: **Beilu AIRP** renders LLM-authored DSL tags (scene/sym/char/desc) into styled HTML — colored text and symbol art. Numeric state stays in deterministic code; the LLM only writes the narrative skin.
en-UK.author: 凛倾

zh-CN.name: AIRP渲染
zh-CN.description: 符号化场景渲染：DSL标签映射为styled HTML
zh-CN.description_markdown: **AIRP渲染** 将 LLM 输出的 DSL 标签（scene/sym/char/desc）渲染为 styled HTML——彩色文本与符号画。数值留在确定性代码里，LLM 只负责叙事皮肤。
zh-CN.author: 凛倾
